text: Inspect work progress, equipment, or construction sites to verify safety or to ensure that specifications are met.
Monitor and analyze sales promotion results to determine cost effectiveness of promotion campaigns.
Review development plans for transportation system effects, infrastructure requirements, or compliance with applicable transportation regulations.
Recommend methods for improving utilization of personnel, material, and utilities.
Adjust or repair testing, electrical, or mechanical equipment or devices.
Conduct engineering site audits to collect structural, electrical, and related site information for use in the design of residential or commercial solar power systems.
Supervise or advise subordinate personnel.
Communicate geothermal plant conditions to employees.
Maintain daily logs and supplement inspection records with photographs.
Assign stories to other reporters or duties to production staff.
Demagnetize mechanisms, using demagnetizing machines.
Incorporate new manufacturing methods or processes to improve existing operations.
Monitor work productivity or quality to ensure compliance with standard operating procedures.
Supervise solar installers, technicians, and subcontractors for solar installation projects to ensure compliance with safety standards.
Study communication code languages or foreign languages to translate intelligence.
Observe students' performance, and record relevant data to assess progress.
Advise dealers and distributors on policies and operating procedures to ensure functional effectiveness of business.
Perform failure, variation, or root cause analyses.
Escort customers to their vehicles to ensure their safety.
Prepare manuals and train workers in use of new forms, reports, procedures or equipment, according to organizational policy.
Administer online purchasing systems.
Maintain and perform safety inspections on equipment and tools.
Develop or deliver training programs for health information technology, creating operating manuals as needed.
Review, negotiate, or approve wind farm contracts.
Arrange for the replacement of defective fire fighting equipment and for repair of fire alarm and sprinkler systems, making minor repairs such as servicing fire extinguishers when feasible.

Identify opportunities or develop channels for purchase or sale of securities or commodities.

Prepare technical reports for use by engineering, management, or sales personnel.
Mix finish ingredients to obtain desired colors or shades.
Develop and maintain relationships with banking, insurance, and external accounting personnel to facilitate financial activities.

Plan and promote sporting events and social, cultural, and recreational activities.

Recommend and implement measures to improve worker motivation, work methods, or customer services.
Direct workers in transportation or related services, such as pumping, moving, storing, or loading or unloading of materials.
Book transportation and hotel reservations, using computer or telephone.
Develop Web site performance metrics.
Prepare and negotiate advertising and sales contracts.
Gather personnel records from other departments or employees.
Collaborate with sales teams to understand customer requirements, to promote the sale of company products, and to provide sales support.
Plan and prepare work schedules, and assign employees to specific duties.
Operate equipment such as forklifts.
Perform foreign currency transactions and sell traveler's checks.
Issue or distribute materials, products, parts, and supplies to customers or coworkers, based on information from incoming requisitions.
Propose, review, or approve modifications to project plans.
Provide customers with product samples and catalogs.
Conduct individual assessments, including interpreting measures and providing feedback for selection, placement, or promotion.
